# Deckard 1.12.1 - an alarm when an update is found

A small addition in the **Deckard window**.

## What is new

- **An alarm when a newer Deckard is available.** When Deckard finds a newer release, it now plays a short alarm sound as the "update available" banner appears, as well as showing the banner. The sound is built into Deckard, plays once in the background, and is simply skipped if the computer has no sound device, so it can never stop the banner from showing.

## Things to know

- **Nothing else changes.** The update check, the banner and every comparison tool work as they did in 1.12.0.
- **Sound credit.** The alarm is "Alarm" by Macro, from OpenGameArt, licensed CC-BY 3.0; the credit is in the README.
